lines.1: I wondered... Every one of them was miles away from my image of a girlfriend.
lines.2: Though I honestly couldn't complain about being surrounded by beautiful girls.
lines.3: ...Speaking of beautiful girls, there was her too.
lines.5: ...No. I was going to forget about her.
lines.6: I looked up through the window.
lines.7: --The sky was perfectly clear as far as the eye could see.
lines.8: Even though tomorrow would mark the beginning of a turbulent new school life--
